cases.purpose: A non-root cron daemon dispatching a system crontab row and a cron.d row that carry a USER column keeps its own uid but runs each command with USER, LOGNAME, HOME from the named account, SHELL and PATH from the table environment or the documented defaults.
cases.oracle: cron_doc: non-root daemon runs keep the daemon uid but still set USER, LOGNAME, HOME, SHELL and PATH. Expected HOME/shell values come from GNU getent passwd in the guest (checked in-script: daemon home /usr/sbin, root home /root and shell /bin/bash), the uid from GNU id -u of the same process, the fixed clock 1700000040 matches every minute of the star rows.
cases.comparison: Exact stdout: the exit status of one cron run --once poll with a fixed clock, and the six lines each job wrote (GNU id -u and the environment seen by the job), for one /etc/crontab-shaped row with explicit SHELL= and PATH= environment lines and one cron.d row relying on the defaults.
cases.script:
export TZ=UTC
w=$PWD/cronw
mkdir -p "$w/etc" "$w/cron.d" "$w/spool" "$w/out" "$w/mail"
want_uid=$(/usr/bin/id -u)
IFS=: read -r _ _ _ _ _ dhome dshell < <(/usr/bin/getent passwd daemon)
IFS=: read -r _ _ _ _ _ rhome rshell < <(/usr/bin/getent passwd root)
printf '%s\n' \
  'SHELL=/bin/bash' \
  'PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/opt/rowpath' \
  "* * * * * daemon { /usr/bin/id -u; echo \"\$USER\"; echo \"\$LOGNAME\"; echo \"\$HOME\"; echo \"\$SHELL\"; echo \"\$PATH\"; } > $w/row1" > "$w/etc/crontab"
printf '%s\n' \
  "* * * * * root { /usr/bin/id -u; echo \"\$USER\"; echo \"\$LOGNAME\"; echo \"\$HOME\"; echo \"\$SHELL\"; echo \"\$PATH\"; } > $w/row2" > "$w/cron.d/second"
BASHCRON_SPOOL_DIR=$w/spool BASHCRON_OUTPUT_DIR=$w/out BASHCRON_ETC_DIR=$w/etc BASHCRON_CROND_DIR=$w/cron.d \
  BASHCRON_MAIL_DIR=$w/mail BASHCRON_NOW_EPOCH=1700000040 cron run --once
echo "cron-status=$?"
show() {
  local f=$1 l=() line
  [[ -f $f ]] || { echo "$f missing"; return; }
  while IFS= read -r line; do l+=("$line"); done < "$f"
  echo "$2 uid=${l[0]} USER=${l[1]} LOGNAME=${l[2]} HOME=${l[3]} SHELL=${l[4]} PATH=${l[5]}"
  [[ ${l[0]} == "$want_uid" ]] && echo "$2 keeps-daemon-uid=yes" || echo "$2 keeps-daemon-uid=NO($want_uid)"
}
show "$w/row1" row1
show "$w/row2" row2
[[ $dhome == /usr/sbin && $rhome == /root && $rshell == /bin/bash ]] && echo "getent-oracle=agrees" || echo "getent-oracle=differs:$dhome:$rhome:$rshell"
cases.stdout:
cron-status=0
row1 uid=2000 USER=daemon LOGNAME=daemon HOME=/usr/sbin SHELL=/bin/bash PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/opt/rowpath
row1 keeps-daemon-uid=yes
row2 uid=2000 USER=root LOGNAME=root HOME=/root SHELL=/bin/bash PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
row2 keeps-daemon-uid=yes
getent-oracle=agrees
